Step: 1232 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply).  
From 09-17 back 345 days:  
Go back 17 days to 09-00 → 08-31 (since Sept has 30 days, Aug 31). That’s 17 days subtracted.  
Remaining: 345 − 17 = 328 days earlier in the same year 1232.  
Go back through months:  
Aug 31 → (Aug 31 days) back 31 days to Jul 31: total 48 days.  
Jul 31 → back 31 days to Jun 30: total 79 days.  
Jun 30 → back 30 days to May 31: total 109 days.  
May 31 → back 31 days to Apr 30: total 140 days.  
Apr 30 → back 30 days to Mar 31: total 170 days.  
Mar 31 → back 31 days to Feb 29 (leap year): total 201 days.  
Feb 29 → back 29 days to Jan 31: total 230 days.  
Jan 31 → back 31 days to Dec 31, 1231: total 261 days.  
Remaining: 328 − 261 = 67 days earlier in 1231 (not leap).  
Dec 31, 1231 → back 31 days to Nov 30: total 292 days.  
Remaining: 67 − 31 = 36 days earlier.  
Nov 30 → back 30 days to Oct 31: total 322 days.  
Remaining: 36 − 30 = 6 days earlier.  
Oct 31 → back 6 days to Oct 25, 1231.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1231-10-25
